basic_info.description: Set in a central neighborhood sandwiched between Mission, Bernal Hts, Excelsior, Portola, this classic home has been gloriously updated for today's life. Detailed facade stands proudly above the street. Welcoming entry stairs and landing usher you into the main floor. Grand living room abuts renovated modern skylit kitchen with bright dining area. In the quiet back are two spacious bedrooms w/ views spanning hills & city. Renovated hall bath w/ skylight completes this floor. Head downstairs for huge bonus room - so large it can be divided for sleeping and office areas - with walk-in closet. Brand new custom-tiled bath with bidet toilet and enormous luxury shower. (Downstairs rooms unwarranted; bedroom down has low ceiling.) 1-car garage w/laundry hookups, storage space. Step out a view deck & back yard-multiple terraces incl patio, grassy lawn, gardens. A complete life is here at home!  All of this conveniently located in quiet residential neighborhood near some of the best of SF. Head to Mission Street, Portola's San Bruno Ave, Bernal Heights' Cortland Ave for restaurants, coffee, shops. St Mary's, Glen Canyon and McLaren Park offer outdoor recreation aplenty. Balboa Park BART and numerous Muni lines are all around, not to mention ready freeway access. Grab this gem!
